# SetFont

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Fonts and Text](BlitzBasic-Fonts-and-Text)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetFont:Void font:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `font` | In | Int32 | required | A handle from [LoadFont](LoadFont). 0 goes back to the built-in font. |

## Description

Chooses the font that [Text](Text), [Print](Print), [StringWidth](StringWidth) and the other text commands use from now on.

## Differences

* A font that does not exist stops the program with an error message.

## Related Commands

[FontHeight](FontHeight), [FontWidth](FontWidth), [FreeFont](FreeFont), [LoadFont](LoadFont)
